Do you not mind doing physically challenging work? Do you also prefer not to work for too long in a row? Then the job as a warehouse employee at DPD Tynaarlo is something for you! You only work a maximum of 6 hours per day. Do you want to know what we offer? Then read on!

What we offer
- A gross salary of € 14,99 per hour (18+)
- An allowance of 45% extra
- Allowance of 50% on Saturday (€ 22.48 per hour!)
- Parttime hours (between 4 to 6 hours per day)
- A working atmosphere rated with an 8+
- Chance of a fixed contract after 12 weeks

Who you are
As a warehouse employee at DPD in Tynaarlo you like to get things done. In addition, we ask the following things from you:

- You are available at least 4 days a week
- You speak Dutch or English
- You have your own transport to get to the work location
- You are available in the afternoon and in the morning

What will you do
As a warehouse employee you will work in the sorting process of DPD Tynaarlo. You are responsible for loading and unloading trucks. You will also manually sort and scan packages. Please note, this can sometimes be a bit harder work! Fortunately, you don't have to do this for long, because the shifts are shorter than 8 hours per day. You can work in the following shifts:

- Night shift: Monday from 6:45 am to 10:00 am
- Morning shift: Tuesday to Saturday from 4:00 AM to 07:30 AM
- Afternoon shift: Monday to Friday from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM

Where will you work
At DPD Tynaarlo you will end up in a company where collaboration is paramount. They have a good working atmosphere in the warehouse. Every day, many warehouse employees are busy sorting packages and loading/unloading the trucks. The delivery drivers are also supported with loading the vans. #baanrader

Job application
Do you see yourself working in the DPD warehouse in Tynaarlo? Then apply quickly! I will call you within one working day and discuss what a warehouse employee does. Do you have any questions? Reassure them! You can email or call me

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can be delivered to customers on time.

Your responsibilities include placing packages on the sorting conveyor belt, processing sorted shipments, and supporting the daily logistics operation. You will work Monday to Friday and be available 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Start and end times may vary.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier or difficult to lift, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available for at least 3 to 4 days per week
- You are at least 18 years old
- You speak Dutch or English
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center
